Research / Biological risk & resilience

Biological safeguard stability

Will a built-in safety mechanism retain its intended function as a population evolves? We examine the effects of mutation, selection, and fitness trade-offs on safeguard durability.

Risk programme↗

Questions & challenges

  • Predicting compensatory mutations
  • Understanding fitness trade-offs
  • Modeling gene circuit degradation
  • Assessing cross-feeding dynamics

Mathematical approaches

  • Population genetics theory
  • Evolutionary game theory
  • Mutation-selection balance models
  • Experimental evolution validation

Applications

  • Robust kill-switch design principles
  • Multi-layered safety system optimization
  • Auxotrophy strategy evaluation
  • Genetic firewall development

Mechanisms, evidence, and uncertainty.

Population genetics, stochastic processes, mathematical modeling, and comparison with observations connect this question to our wider forecasting programme.
